scope: Toom-3, dedicated recursive squaring, fixed production dispatch, MAC4 candidate

oracle.coverage: Default and forced recursion, three low splits, n mod 3, signed/zero evaluations, full MAX carry chains, all top bits, immutable input alias, nonzero storage, exact scratch and surrounding canaries, row tails including empty, quotient/remainder

codegen.scope: Actual fixed product/square dispatch; arbitrary-divisor API excluded from division-free claim
codegen.retained_checks: Entry assertions and slice-region checks; required copying and zero fill retained

mac4_candidate.limitation: Experimental unrolling retains per-element checks on this compiler; measured separately

benchmark.semantics: Multiplication or square modulo 2^p, including required copying/masking. Public GMP mul_n/sqr computes full product first. Allocation setup excluded, GMP internal allocation not instrumented.
benchmark.controls: Previous verified Karatsuba, forced Toom splits, full Toom, GMP, actual default; no isolated proof-overhead inference. Row control uses original loop and public GMP addmul_1.
benchmark.parameter_columns: threshold/low_limit describe forced modes 1-3; modes 0,4,5 ignore scan context. Default product: K below 512, else 192/128/9:40. Default square: 192/64/11:36.
benchmark.mac4_workload: Same initial destination and common iteration count across modes; destination reset outside timing and final states compared.
benchmark.mac4_policy: Kept as verified candidate; no consistent win over original carry loop in local measurements.
benchmark.square_base_policy: Full-square leaves use the symmetric kernel from 8 limbs; below 8 retain generic multiplication. Direct specialized low-square leaf selected only for top-level square sizes 25 through 64; original generic low path otherwise.

cost.low: L(n)=T(n-h)+2L(h)+O(n), h=floor(9n/40) or floor(11n/36) or floor(n/2)
cost.square: Dedicated five-point squares; low square computes one cross multiplication and adds it twice
cost.square_base: Triangular n(n-1)/2 cross products plus n diagonal products, one zero fill and one fused doubling/diagonal pass; O(n^2) operations and O(1) extra words, no extra scratch. Operation formula is analytic.
cost.bound: O(n^log3(5)) word operations for fixed Toom/base thresholds and all three low splits; analytic derivation, not checked cost theorem
cost.scratch_words: Full/low product 12n, full/low square 10n; checked recursive capacity; O(log n) call depth
